StockAdjustmentItemSerializer.validate_p.justification: `get_global_setting(..., backup_value=False, cache=False)`: `backup_value` only applies when the setting row is missing (never) and `cache` only changes caching of a setting read; no observable difference.

StockAdjustmentSerializer.validate|delet.justification: The base `Serializer.validate` returns its argument unchanged: deleting the call has no effect.

StockAddSerializer.save|or -> and.justification: Redundant guard: for quantity 0 (or negative) `add_stock` itself returns False (model-level guard), so skipping the item in `save()` is unobservable.

StockAddSerializer.save|<= -> <.justification: Redundant guard: for quantity 0 (or negative) `add_stock` itself returns False (model-level guard), so skipping the item in `save()` is unobservable.

StockAddSerializer.save|POSITIVE_GUARD q.justification: Redundant guard: for quantity 0 (or negative) `add_stock` itself returns False (model-level guard), so skipping the item in `save()` is unobservable.

StockRemoveSerializer.save|or -> and.justification: Redundant guard: for quantity 0 `take_stock` itself returns False, so the serializer-level skip is unobservable.

StockRemoveSerializer.save|<= -> <.justification: Redundant guard: for quantity 0 `take_stock` itself returns False, so the serializer-level skip is unobservable.

StockRemoveSerializer.save|POSITIVE_GUAR.justification: Redundant guard: for quantity 0 `take_stock` itself returns False, so the serializer-level skip is unobservable.

StockItem.add_stock|delete statement: tr.justification: The quantity delta is dropped from `additional_data` (it is recorded as a field change, `changes['quantity']`, which the tests assert), so the value is inert.

StockItem.take_stock|<= -> <.justification: First `quantity <= 0` guard: the second guard after the `min()` clamp rejects the same input, so moving this boundary has no effect.

StockItem.take_stock|POSITIVE_GUARD quan.justification: First `quantity <= 0` guard: the second guard after the `min()` clamp rejects the same input, so moving this boundary has no effect.

StockItem.save|and -> or.justification: `(user or notes) and not has_pending_event`: with `or`, an extra `audit_event(...)` context is opened; the audit layer attaches it to the same entry, so the number and content of audit entries are identical (checked by `test_update_save_inside_a_pending_event_adds_exactly_one_audit_entry`).

StockItem.delete|False -> True.justification: `cache=False` argument of `get_global_setting` (caching of a setting read): no observable difference.

StockAdjustView.get_serializer_context|d.justification: DRF `GenericAPIView.get_serializer_context` already supplies `request`; the explicit assignment is redundant.
